==Description==
The Blindseer Glyphs are luminescent messages that are only revealed once the player obtains the [[Blindseer]] [[Oath]]. There are currently three glyphs that reveal information regarding [[The City of the Drowned]] (The City of Celtor) and how to progress Blindseer.

==Location==
The Blindseer Glyphs are located separately throughout the Etrean and Eastern Luminant, their locations are:
*[[Lightkeeper Temple]], in the large room with the [[King Thresher]].
*[[Summer Isle]], at the old shrine behind the [[Inn]].
*[[The Temple of the Forgotten Flame]], on the path behind to the cliff.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Blindseer Glyph Lightkeeper Map.png|Lightkeeper Temple
Blindseer Glyph Summer Map.png|Summer Isle
Blindseer Glyph Temple Map.png|The Temple of the Forgotten Flame
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|Base Dialogues=
This dialogue appears on all the glyphs if the player does not meet the requirements for Blindseer.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*Strangely luminescent glyphs are arranged before you. You feel as though there is little for you to learn from them.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]

|-|Unlockable Dialogues=
{{#tag:tabber|Lightkeeper Temple=
This dialogue is unlocked once the player has obtained Blindseer.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}First Encounter
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Subsequent Encounters
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Strangely luminescent glyphs are arranged before you. Something in your gut lurches staring at them, as if another land was calling your name.*''
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You have learnt what there is to learn from these glyphs. Further educations lie in wait in the world around you.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Inspect]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*With your blindfold tightly bound, light from the glyphs seems to pierce through the blindfold. The light rearranges into a missive now legible. It details a City of long gone, sunken Celtor - A horrible drowning swallowed Celtor - this is known by all - though, what few failed to notice was the arrival of their new Lord and King many years before. This leader brought prosperity to them in a time of need, but in a world so cruel why did none think to question the hand of one so generous?*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]

{{!}}-{{!}}Summer Isle Glyph=
This dialogue is unlocked once the player has obtained Blindseer.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}First Encounter
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Subsequent Encounters
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Strangely luminescent glyphs are arranged before you. Something in your gut lurches staring at them, as if another land was calling your name.*''
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You have learnt what there is to learn from these glyphs. Further educations lie in wait in the world around you.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Inspect]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*With your blindfold tightly bound, light from the glyphs seems to pierce through the blindfold. The light rearranges into a missive now legible. It details the duty of your {{g|Oaths|Oath}} - free the lost souls from their shackles, help them escape into the light.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]

{{!}}-{{!}}The Temple of the Forgotten Flame=
These dialogues are unlocked once the player has met the requirements for Blindseer or already has the Oath.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}First Encounter
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Subsequent Encounters
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*Strangely luminescent glyphs are arranged before you. Something in your gut lurches staring at them, as if another land was calling your name.*''
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*You have learnt what there is to learn from these glyphs. Further educations lie in wait in the world around you.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Inspect]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Blindfold equipped
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}No Blindfold equipped
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*With your blindfold tightly bound, light from the glyphs seems to pierce through the blindfold. The light rearranges into a missive now legible. It details the tenets of an {{g|Oaths|Oath}} - that we are born with our eyes closed, and we merely choose to open them.*''
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The writing on the rock is inscrutable. Whenever your eyes begin to focus on the glyphs, they seem to switch positions. Somehow, it feels like your '''vision''' is failing you.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Take the Oath]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You vow the {{g|Oaths|Oath}} to yourself, fixing your destiny in place. Power springs forth like the water of a fountain.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player obtains [[Blindseer]]
}}

==Trivia==
*The Blindseer Glyph at The Temple of the Forgotten Flame is visually different from the glyphs at Summer Isle and Lightkeeper Temple.

==Description==
"???" is an [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They are an individual turning into a [[Mudskipper]].

They are the only passive [[Mudskipper]], and they have the ability to talk using proper words.

==Location==
It resides in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]] in the first layer of [[the Depths]], in [[Celtor Wastes]]. You can find it near the Widow's Cave entangled in a clump of coral.
<gallery widths="300px">
File:Question Mark Mudskipper Location.png
</gallery>

== Dialogue ==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="12" |''*What you thought was a clump of coral begins to move.*'' Gh... Hail there... come now... Won't you speak wi'h me...?
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Gah! What are you? 
|-
| colspan="12" |Grgh... Just a talkative stranger, that's all... It's so... Tranquil here... ''*The creature wheezes as it takes in another breath.*'' Just watchin' it all go by...
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |This is a nightmare.
|-
| colspan="12" |No dreams when we're already dead, friend... This is what the Grrrgh... The Gods left us in the end... Come, won't you sit with me?... We have so much talk about...
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Trivia==
*Its skin tone is slightly darker compared to other Mudskippers, and uses a standard [[Aspects|human]] face rather than a Mudskipper face.

|location=[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]]}}

==Description==
??? is an [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. It is used to summon the [[Scion of Ethiron]].

It appears as a purple tempest holding the souls of the [[Kyrsgarde]].
{{clear}}

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="12" |''*Before you a swirling tempest of eternity looms. Its gravity tugs on your very soul, threatening to pull you under its current and cast you against the jagged edges that lurk within. To {{sh|UNDO}} you. The wind howls.*''
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |[Resist it]
|-
| colspan="12" |''*You force yourself away from the vortex. Deep inside you know that if you so much as make contact with this force, you will no longer exist in this world.*''
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |[Resist further]
|-
| colspan="12" |''*The howling breaks, giving way to a cacophony of alien screams that drown out all your senses and leave you crushed beneath their weight. This close to the source, you realise what lurks within the tempest. A vestige of a force greater than any. A {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} souls wail in an agony sublime.*''
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |[Resist with all that you are]
|-
| colspan="12" |''*Without even a whimper, the only sound left is your ragged breathing. Despite the gale, you remain. For but a few fleeting moments, it seems as if the storm has passed.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |[Breathe out]
|-
| colspan="12" |{{sh|Wake}}.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], Scion of Ethiron is summoned
|}

==Trivia==
*The entity who awakens the Scion by telling it to "Wake" is none other than [[Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron]] himself.<ref>[[File:ArchVoice.png|300px]]</ref>
